title: Clayton Community Tree Planting Day
description: A beginner-friendly planting session with tools and guidance provided.

title: Box Hill Habitat Care Morning
description: Help restore local habitat through mulching, weeding, and native planting.

title: Yarra Native Garden Workshop
description: Learn simple ways to support native plants, insects, and birds at home.

title: Richmond Pollinator Garden Planting
description: Plant native shrubs and small trees to create a welcoming garden for pollinators. Beginners can practise planting and watering with volunteer guidance.

title: Carlton Native Seed Workshop
description: Explore how native seeds develop and practise sowing supplied seeds in reusable pots. Learn how to care for seedlings at home.

title: Brunswick Habitat Mulching Morning
description: Help spread mulch around established native plants and check their watering needs. This hands-on session introduces simple ways to care for young habitat gardens.

title: Footscray Community Canopy Day
description: Join a community planting session focused on growing future shade. Volunteers will prepare planting holes, plant young trees and add protective mulch.

title: Glen Waverley Wildlife Garden Workshop
description: Plan a small garden with shelter, flowering plants and water for local wildlife. Create a simple planting sketch suited to the space available at home.

title: Clayton Young Tree Care Session
description: Care for recently planted trees by checking guards, removing nearby weeds and refreshing mulch. Learn what to look for during regular tree-care visits.

title: Box Hill Native Understorey Planting
description: Add native shrubs and groundcover beneath an existing tree canopy. Learn how several layers of vegetation can provide more shelter for wildlife.

title: Hawthorn Urban Birdwatching Workshop
description: Practise observing common urban birds and recording what you notice without disturbing them. Discuss how native planting supports food and nesting habitats.

title: Coburg Habitat Weeding Working Bee
description: Help remove selected weeds from a community habitat garden under volunteer guidance. Finish by checking native seedlings and planning the next care session.

title: Preston Neighbourhood Shade Planting
description: Work in small teams to plant shade trees and companion native shrubs. Tools and a planting demonstration will help first-time volunteers get started.

title: Northcote Native Plant Identification Walk
description: Take a guided learning walk to compare native leaves, flowers and growth habits. Practise keeping a plant observation journal without picking specimens.

title: Fitzroy Pocket Garden Habitat Care
description: Refresh a small community garden by weeding, mulching and caring for groundcover. Discover how even compact green spaces can support local biodiversity.

title: South Yarra Native Tree Planting
description: Help plant native trees and shrubs in a shared green space. Teams will practise correct planting depth, gentle watering and basic aftercare.

title: St Kilda Coastal Plant Learning Session
description: Learn about native plants adapted to coastal conditions through a guided discussion and observation activity. Explore ideas for resilient home gardens.

title: Elwood Habitat Watering Morning
description: Support newly planted habitat beds with a supervised watering and mulch check. Learn how to notice dry soil and keep plant-care records.

title: Caulfield Community Green Corridor Planting
description: Plant a mix of native trees and shrubs to help connect patches of community greenery. Volunteers can take on planting, mulching or watering tasks.

title: Carnegie Small-Space Native Garden Workshop
description: Design a native container garden for a courtyard or balcony. Compare plant needs and plan a manageable watering and maintenance routine.

title: Oakleigh Community Habitat Refresh
description: Give an established native garden a seasonal refresh with light weeding and mulching. Volunteers will record plant condition to guide future maintenance.

title: Mount Waverley Family Planting Morning
description: Introduce families to planting native trees and shrubs through small group activities. Children can help with watering while accompanied by an adult.

title: Burwood Pollinator Observation Workshop
description: Observe insects visiting flowers and practise recording their activity from a respectful distance. Learn how varied flowering plants can support pollinators.

title: Doncaster Native Garden Maintenance Day
description: Join a volunteer team to weed, mulch and check plant guards in a native garden. No previous gardening experience is needed for the guided tasks.

title: Heidelberg Community Woodland Planting
description: Help establish young native trees and supporting shrubs in a community planting area. Learn how plant spacing and aftercare contribute to healthy growth.

title: Ivanhoe Backyard Biodiversity Workshop
description: Explore practical changes that make a backyard more welcoming to birds and insects. Build a personal action list covering plants, shelter and ongoing care.

title: Kensington Native Groundcover Care
description: Care for native groundcover by removing competing weeds and checking soil moisture. Discuss how low-growing plants protect soil and support small wildlife.

title: Ascot Vale Community Tree Planting
description: Meet other volunteers while planting a new group of native trees. The session includes a practical planting demonstration and a shared aftercare checklist.

title: Essendon Habitat Mapping Workshop
description: Sketch the plants and habitat features in a local green space. Use your observations to suggest places where additional native planting could help wildlife.

title: Moonee Ponds Summer Habitat Care
description: Prepare a community habitat garden for warmer weather by checking mulch and watering needs. Work with volunteers to record follow-up tasks for the coming weeks.
